question.text: Copper becomes green when exposed to moist air for a long period. This is due to :

options.text: The formation of a layer of cupric hydroxide on the surface of copper.
The formation of a layer of basic carbonate of copper on the surface of copper.
The formation of basic copper sulphate layer on the surface of the metal.
The formation of a layer of cupric oxide on the surface of copper.

solution.text: Due to formation of Basic copper carbonate CuCO<sub>3</sub>.Cu(OH)<sub>2</sub> in atmosphere.
